title: HTTP/3 WebSocket Handler Exception Close Policy Work Item
summary: Add configured status-code and reason policy for unexpected accepted WebSocket handler exceptions.
planned_changes:
- Add `Http3ServerOptions.WebSocketHandlerExceptionCloseStatusCode` and `WebSocketHandlerExceptionCloseReason` with close-payload validation.
- Use the configured close status and reason in the accepted-tunnel handler-exception catch path.
- Preserve the existing default 1011/internal-error behavior.
- Add a loopback server test that configures a policy close frame and verifies the accepted tunnel receives it after handler failure.
verification_plan: Run the focused HTTP/3 minimal server WebSocket handler-exception close-policy test, adjacent WebSocket regression tests, core SpecTrace validation, regenerated QUIC requirement triage, and diff hygiene.
out_of_scope: TCP proxy policy, backpressure, or stress coverage.
QUIC transport runtime, ACK, recovery, pacing, or packet-protection changes.
completion_notes: Accepted WebSocket tunnel handler failures can now use configured close status and reason policy while preserving the default 1011/internal-error behavior.
